Recovery.recoveryIntro: Use these tools if you (or the CAD owner) are locked out. They change the CAD database directly and require the recovery token stored on the server. Back up your database before making changes.
Recovery.recoveryTokenHelp: The token is stored on the API server in the file apps/api/.recovery-token (readable only by the user running SnailyCAD). It is never sent by email or shown in logs.
Recovery.recoveryRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
Recovery.unknownError: Something went wrong. Check the API logs for details.
Recovery.searchUsersHelp: Search by username, user ID, Discord ID or Steam ID. Leave empty to list the first 25 users (owners first).
Recovery.selectUserFirst: Select a user from the list above to see the user actions.
Recovery.actionSuccess: Done. The change has been applied.
Recovery.newPasswordHelp: At least 8 characters. Give the new password to the user through a private channel.
Recovery.action_enableRegularLogin_description: Turns on the ALLOW_REGULAR_LOGIN feature so users can log in with their username and password. Use this when Discord or Steam login is broken. Owners can already log in with a password even when this is off.
Recovery.action_disableForcedOAuth_description: Turns off FORCE_DISCORD_AUTH and FORCE_STEAM_AUTH, so users are no longer required to connect a Discord or Steam account before using the CAD.
Recovery.action_disableWhitelist_description: Turns off the CAD whitelist so new accounts are accepted automatically. This affects the whole server: anyone can register and use the CAD until you turn it back on in CAD settings.
Recovery.action_resetPassword_description: Sets a new password for this user, removes any temporary password and logs the user out everywhere.
Recovery.action_disable2FA_description: Removes 2FA from this user so they can log in without an authenticator code. They can enable it again from their account settings.
Recovery.action_unlinkDiscord_description: Removes the Discord connection from this user. Use this when the user changed Discord accounts or Discord login fails. If the user has no password, reset their password too, or they cannot log in.
Recovery.action_unlinkSteam_description: Removes the Steam connection from this user.
Recovery.action_restoreUserAccess_description: Unbans this user and sets their whitelist status to accepted. Use this when an account was locked out by a ban or a pending/declined whitelist status.
Recovery.action_makeOwner_description: Gives this user the OWNER rank (full access), unbans them and accepts them. Only use this if the owner account is lost.
Recovery.databaseSettingsIntro: If the recovery tools cannot be used (for example the API does not start), you can connect to the database directly. The settings are in the .env file in the SnailyCAD root folder. Never share these values.
Recovery.databaseUrlInfo: Prisma (the API) only reads DATABASE_URL. Its format is postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/DB_NAME?sslmode=prefer. In the default .env it is built from POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, DB_HOST, DB_PORT and POSTGRES_DB, so if you change one of those, make sure DATABASE_URL still matches (or write the values directly into DATABASE_URL).
Recovery.manageToken: Locating, rotating and replacing the token
Recovery.manageToken_locate: Locate: on the API server, run cat apps/api/.recovery-token from the SnailyCAD folder. The exact absolute path is shown on the admin dashboard for the owner. Set RECOVERY_TOKEN_FILE in .env to use another location.
Recovery.manageToken_rotate: Rotate: as the owner, open the admin dashboard and click "Rotate token". The new token is shown once and replaces the old one immediately.
Recovery.manageToken_replace: Replace: if you cannot log in, delete apps/api/.recovery-token and apps/api/.recovery-token.json and restart the API. A new token is generated, and you can read it from the file.
Recovery.adminTokenDescription: This token unlocks the recovery tools at /auth/recovery if you are ever locked out (for example a broken Discord login, lost 2FA or a forgotten password). It is shown only once. Store it in a password manager.
Recovery.adminTokenManageDescription: The recovery token has been saved. It is stored on the server at the path below. Rotating it creates a new token and makes the old one invalid.
Recovery.adminTokenRotateConfirm: The current token will stop working immediately. Continue?
Recovery.adminTokenUnavailable: The recovery token file could not be read. Check the API logs and file permissions.
